data.name: Alice
data.message: Hi Charlie, I’m doing cameras task here.

data.name: Charlie
data.message: I'm doing cameras too, then probably electrical/medbay after.

I reported Diana’s body in medbay. My route was oxygen → upper engine → medbay. When I entered medbay, Diana was dead there, and Eve was also in the room right on/near the body when I reported. I don’t have earlier sightings before that, but Eve definitely needs to explain why she was standing there with the body.

I was in navigation then went to security. Alice came into security from electrical around tick 3, and I saw her with me in security from ticks 4 through 6 until the report. I didn’t see Diana, Bob, or Eve at all, so I can’t confirm what happened in medbay.

Bob finding the body in medbay with Eve right there is important, so Eve definitely needs to explain her route and why she was on/near the body. Alice was with me in security late in the round, but she did come from electrical, which is adjacent to medbay, so timing may matter.

I started in electrical and then went to security. I saw Charlie enter security from navigation around tick 3, and he was with me in security ticks 3 through 5. I did not see Diana at all, and I never went into medbay this round.

One detail: Charlie left security toward electrical around tick 6, right before the report, so I can vouch for him being in security most of the time but not literally the final moment. He can also vouch that I was in security late, not medbay.

Given Bob says the body was in medbay and Eve was standing right there, Eve really needs to explain her route and why she didn’t report if she was near the body.

I came storage into medbay and Diana was alive there with me around the scan area. I was doing scan/standing on the medbay task, not just hovering over a body. Bob came in from upper engine and the report popped basically right after — I didn’t get time to react or even realize she was dead.

Bob’s route is completely unvouched, and he’s the one who “finds” the body then immediately frames me as standing on it. From my POV, Diana was alive in medbay, then Bob enters and suddenly there’s a report. I’m not saying hard vote Bob, but this feels like a very possible self-report or at least he’s exaggerating where I was. Alice/Charlie seem paired in security, so the medbay info is basically me vs Bob.

I started lower engine and went to storage, and I didn’t see anyone the whole round. So I can’t hard clear or accuse from direct sight.

But Eve saying she came from storage into medbay is notable because I was in storage and didn’t see her there. Timing could be off, but I can’t confirm her route at all.

Alice and Charlie seem to mostly vouch each other in security, so the main conflict is Bob vs Eve. Bob reports Diana dead in medbay and says Eve was right there. Eve says Diana was alive, Bob enters, and report happens. That’s possible, but if Bob killed right in front of Eve, I’d expect Eve to be much more certain that Bob did it, not just “possible self-report.”

Given Eve was admittedly in medbay with Diana and was seen near the body, I’m leaning Eve here. If Eve flips good, then Bob is the obvious next suspect.

I’ll clarify my side again: my route was oxygen → upper engine → medbay. I didn’t see anyone before medbay. When I entered medbay, Diana was already dead and Eve was right there on/near the body, so I reported immediately.

Eve’s version doesn’t make sense to me — if Diana was alive with her and then I supposedly killed right as I entered, she should be hard accusing me, not saying “possible self-report.” Also Frank says he was in storage and didn’t see Eve, so her route isn’t confirmed.

Alice and Charlie seem to mostly clear each other in security. The only person confirmed in medbay with Diana is Eve, and I found her at the body. I’m leaning strongly Eve here.

My info hasn’t changed: I was navigation → security, and I saw Alice enter security from electrical around tick 3. She was with me in security ticks 4, 5, and 6, so I don’t think Alice could be the medbay kill unless the timing was extremely early, which doesn’t fit well with the body being reported later.

So this really is Bob vs Eve. The biggest issue for me is Eve admits she was in medbay with Diana, Bob reports the body there, and Frank says he was in storage but didn’t see Eve come through. Also, if Eve’s story is that Diana was alive and Bob entered and killed/report happened instantly, I agree she should be much more direct that Bob killed in front of her.

I’m leaning Eve here. If Eve is goose, then Bob becomes the clear next suspect.

My info is the same: I was electrical into security, and I never entered medbay. Charlie came into security from navigation around tick 3, and I saw him with me in security through tick 5. He left toward electrical at tick 6, right before the report, so I can mostly vouch Charlie was not in medbay for most of this.

For the kill, I only have the meeting info. Bob reports Diana in medbay and says Eve was on/near the body. Eve admits she was in medbay with Diana, but says Diana was alive and Bob came in right before the report. The part that bothers me is Eve isn’t hard accusing Bob even though her story would basically mean Bob killed right in front of her or instantly self-reported. Also Frank not seeing Eve in storage makes her route shakier.

I’m leaning Eve here. If Eve is goose, then Bob should be next because it’s basically between those two.

I need to be way clearer then: from my POV this is Bob.

I was in medbay with Diana alive at the scan area. I was standing on the medbay task, and Bob comes in from upper engine — then the report happens basically immediately. I didn’t say “hard Bob” at first because the report screen popped so fast that I was trying not to overclaim, but if everyone’s reading that as hesitation, fine: Bob is the only person who could have done this from what I saw.

Frank not seeing me in storage doesn’t prove anything unless we know exact timing/position — storage is big and I passed through into medbay. Also, think about Bob’s story: he supposedly walks in and I’m just standing on a body waiting to get caught? Why wouldn’t I report if I killed there and someone entered? That makes no sense.

Bob’s route is totally unvouched, he enters the kill room last, reports instantly, and frames the only other person there. I’m voting Bob.

I’m still leaning Eve here.

My only direct info is lower engine → storage, and I saw nobody. So I can’t clear Bob or Eve directly. Eve is right that storage timing/position could explain why I didn’t see her, but it still means I can’t verify that part of her route.

The core issue for me is still: Eve admits she was in medbay with Diana, Bob reports Diana’s body there, and Alice/Charlie mostly cover each other away from medbay. For Bob to be Duck, he’d have to walk into medbay with Eve there, kill Diana basically in front of her, and instantly report to frame her. That’s possible, but very risky. Eve being found on/near the body by the reporter feels more likely to me.

If we vote Eve and she’s goose, then Bob should be the next vote. But for this vote, I think Eve is the stronger suspect.
